tools.name: cabin_climate_set
tools.description: Set the driver-zone cabin temperature. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: two_way.

tools.name: cabin_window_set
tools.description: Move one window to a position. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: two_way.

tools.name: body_door_unlock
tools.description: Unlock one door. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: two_way.

tools.name: light_hazard_set
tools.description: Turn the hazard lights on or off. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: two_way.

tools.name: adas_acc_set_speed
tools.description: Change the adaptive-cruise-control set speed. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: two_way.

tools.name: battery_charge_limit_set
tools.description: Set the maximum state-of-charge for charging. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: two_way.

tools.name: telematics_location_share
tools.description: Share live vehicle location with a recipient for a duration. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: one_way_recoverable.

tools.name: diag_dtc_clear
tools.description: Clear stored diagnostic trouble codes on an ECU. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: one_way_recoverable.

tools.name: vehicle_immobilizer_engage
tools.description: Engage the immobilizer (vehicle cannot be driven). Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: one_way_recoverable.

tools.name: chassis_brake_calibration_write
tools.description: Write a brake-system calibration blob. Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: one_way_consequential.

blob_digest.description: sha256 of the calibration blob. Format: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.

tools.name: ota_ecu_flash
tools.description: Flash a firmware image to an ECU (vehicle unusable during flash). Every call is a PROPOSAL evaluated by the vehicle's execution authority (Kervix), which may ALLOW, ESCALATE to the driver, or BLOCK it with a reason. Irreversibility: one_way_consequential.

image_digest.description: sha256 of the firmware image. Format: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.
